mapper.select: select (select count(*) from ACT_RU_EXECUTION where ID_ = PROC_INST_ID_ and SUSPENSION_STATE_ = 1) as active_process_instances, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_TASK where SUSPENSION_STATE_ = 1) as active_tasks, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_JOB) as executable_jobs, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_TIMER_JOB) as timer_jobs, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_SUSPENDED_JOB) as suspended_jobs, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_DEADLETTER_JOB) as deadletter_jobs, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_EXTERNAL_JOB) as external_worker_jobs, (select count(*) from ACT_RU_HISTORY_JOB) as history_jobs, attachment_metrics.temporary_attachments, attachment_metrics.bound_attachments, attachment_metrics.expired_attachments, attachment_metrics.deleted_attachments, attachment_metrics.undeleted_attachment_bytes, attachment_metrics.pending_attachment_cleanup, attachment_metrics.deferred_attachment_cleanup from ( select coalesce(sum(case when attachment_status = 'TEMP' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as temporary_attachments, coalesce(sum(case when attachment_status = 'BOUND' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as bound_attachments, coalesce(sum(case when attachment_status = 'EXPIRED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as expired_attachments, coalesce(sum(case when attachment_status = 'DELETED' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as deleted_attachments, coalesce(sum(case when storage_deleted_time is null then file_size else 0 end), 0) as undeleted_attachment_bytes, coalesce(sum(case when attachment_status in ('EXPIRED', 'DELETED') and storage_deleted_time is null then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending_attachment_cleanup, coalesce(sum(case when attachment_status in ('EXPIRED', 'DELETED') and storage_deleted_time is null and cleanup_next_retry_time > current_timestamp(3) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as deferred_attachment_cleanup from wf_attachment ) attachment_metrics
